negative_snippets:
At the time of booking, I wasn't aware that it was a Fab Stay hotel. I have had issues with Fan stays with regard to cleanliness earlier too. Here also, there was fungus growing on the bathroom door, and the cleaning especially in the areas behind the tables, wardrobes etc leaves much to be desired, (please see the enclosed pictures). Dusting was also not properly done, and most of the time, I had to do it myself!
Hot water was not available for two out of four days of my stay, in spite of reminders at least two - three times a day.
The redeeming feature, was the complementary breakfast, which was good.
There is a bus stop directly in front of the property, the nearest metro station, Vinobapuri, on the pink line is at least a km away. No e-rickshaws not regular autorickshaws are available nearby. There aren't any good restaurants nor good street food available anywhere within a radius of a minimum of a km.
So PLEASE STAY HERE ONLY IF NO OTHER OPTION IS AVAILABLE!!!

Pros: Location is great plus they have balcony rooms at affordable prices. Go for the Room 101, it got the biggest balcony.

Cons: The cleanliness is not upto the mark plus breakfast is close to nothing, you just have 1 option to eat and they amazingly call it “Buffet”🤣

Conveniently located.
They let you extend for half day, this was plus for me.
Rooms was ok.
But signs of overdue service was all around in the room. I had to call housekeeping to remove leftover tea and water from side tables. Coffee spilled in from of door.
Average to poor on service.
TV was not functional, reception guy just handed remote to me and disappeared. Set top box was precariously perched on top. Could fall down.
Free breakfast is not worth. Poori bhaji I did not try. Only cold tea with too much sugar and extra sugar was available. No coffee. I tried bread-butter,  But it was "margarin" for instead of butter. Toaster was dirty and jugad functional.  Overall choose if you just needs bed to spend night in this super hot delhi summer.
